verdict.rationale: Svelte ships an official `sv` CLI with documented commands: `sv create` scaffolds projects, `sv add` adds functionality to existing projects, `sv check` checks code, and another command converts playground URLs into SvelteKit projects. Its docs are also published in LLM-consumable form at /docs/cli/llms.txt. Missing for 10: no evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as non-interactive or machine-readable output modes, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in AI workflows.
